Name: (CP) Mewo from Omori
Author: TipsSlight
Description:
Replaces the second cat with Mewo, the cat from Omori. It is more or less a full rip of the sprite, but there has been some edits to make Mewo hop around and transition from being awake to being asleep.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4011]Adopt 'n Skin[/url] and requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]. For Adopt 'n Skin, a second .png file in the correct format has been provided.





[i]mewo do be a giant black blob of cuddliness, just like most black cats in real life[/i]

Downloads.Description: Main file. For Adopt 'n Skin, use the .png file assets/Cat_15773.
